site.name: Bairview Films
site.tagline: Stories from the Midwest, made in the dark.

about: BairView Films is an independent production company dedicated to original storytelling through film.

Kaleb Fobair is an American filmmaker from Joplin, Missouri. He graduated from Missouri State University with a bachelor's degree in Digital Film & Television Production and is the founder of BairView Films. His work includes narrative films, documentaries, commercials, and digital media. His award-winning short film Room 10 received the Best Heartland College Student Short award at the Kansas City International Film Festival and won Best of Festival at the Fault Line Film Festival. He is also the co-founder of [POW417](https://pow417.com), an anti-AI 48 hour film festival.

films.title: Solus
films.synopsis: When unknown entities descend upon Earth, a recluse must navigate the consequences of their choices and society's fall.

films.title: The Lost Place
films.logline: Two brothers in a ruined world capture a mysterious woman called a "Lost One."
films.synopsis: In a ruined world, two brothers capture a mysterious woman known as a “Lost One.” As one grows close to her, tension rises—threatening their bond and their survival.
laurels: Queen City Shout 2026 (including Best Lead Actor)

films.title: ROADKILL
films.logline: A documentary crew investigates a Missouri cryptid tied to disappearances.
films.synopsis: When a video emerges online showing two young adults' mysterious disappearance, an amateur documentary crew travel to a small, mysterious town in Missouri to investigate a local cryptid tied to the recent disappearances. As they delve deeper, their skepticism fades, and they realize the terror in the woods is far more real than they ever imagined, and it's hunting them.
laurels: Creature Feature Weekend 2025 (Official Selection and Honorable Mention)

films.title: Room 10
films.logline: Newlyweds inherit a run-down family motel, and outlaw guests expose mistrust in their marriage.
films.synopsis: Newlyweds, Arthur and Holly unexpectedly must take over the run-down motel that has been passed down in Arthur's family for generations. Tensions run high as they struggle to keep the motel afloat, and problems within their marriage emerge. When a pair of outlaws check into the motel, Arthur and Holly have different ideas on what to do. The two strangers unassumingly bring out the darkest parts of both husband and wife, creating a domino-effect of mistrust. Their misalliance may result in a deadly ending.
laurels: Kansas City FilmFest 2025 (Best Heartland College Student Short)
